muse-glimmer-webgpu-kernels  (self-contained WebGPU GGUF runtime for Muse Glimmer 30B)
  for the local WebGPU runner's muse-glimmer engine (extension/offscreen/local-model.js).
  from: https://huggingface.co/spaces/webml-community/muse-glimmer-webgpu-kernels
  space commit: 24cb8aa (author: Xenova), file: index.html (sdk: static)

what this is: the Space's inline ESM runtime bundle - custom WGSL kernels, a GGUF
parser, K-quant/IQ transcoders, a graph compiler, and the MuseGlimmer30B model
class (checkAvailability / load / generate / dispose). It is NOT Transformers.js:
the Space ships its own specialized GGUF WebGPU runtime, and peerd vendors it as a
second local engine alongside the vendored Transformers.js (which is ONNX-only).

how it was extracted: the second <script type="module"> block of index.html, up to
and including its export statement (export{... MuseGlimmer30B ...};). The page
controller that follows the export (DOM wiring for the Space's own UI) is NOT
included - importing it would crash in the offscreen document. The bundle has no
static or dynamic imports (the Space's esm.sh imports live in the page's FIRST
script block, which is page decoration only); Node builtin paths are stubbed to
throw and are unreachable in the browser.

provenance note: the bytes were transcribed from the page source supplied by the
repo owner, because the build environment's egress policy blocks huggingface.co /
hf.space. Verify against the live Space when re-vendoring.

runtime facts (from the bundle):
  DEFAULT_MODEL_ID  = unsloth/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF
  DEFAULT_GGUF_FILE = Muse-Glimmer-30B-UD-Q2_K_XL.gguf
  weights cache: IndexedDB (gguf-cache-v1) + a Cache API header cache; weights
  stream from huggingface.co via HTTP range requests (rides connect-src https:).
